title: Youre Being Lied To About Nonverbal Cues #Shorts
topic: Subconscious body language cues: How to read anyone like an open book
script: You think you know someone, but are you just reading the wrong signs? Did you know that 93% of communication is nonverbal? From the way they cross their arms to the angle of their shoulders, every single detail tells a story. But what if the story you're telling yourself is completely wrong? (pause) You're nodding in agreement, but are you really paying attention? (pause) The eyes, the smile, the fidgeting hands - they're all sending secret messages. And the truth is, you'll never truly understand someone until you learn to see beyond the surface. Can you ever truly know someone? Or are you just reading the same script?
